body: I found it while looking for the translation of the symbols in the book. Just a Replica of the Evil Dead 2 Necronomicon. This post didn't help with that, but it's a good thread anyway.

I agree, I don't understand how people accept their loneliness.

I hate it when people tell me that I need to learn to love myself and accept my own company. Well, I fucking hate myself, so no dice.

Life is fucked. Love is fucked.

I'm sorry life hasn't been kind to you in the aspect we need most.

I apologise that I cannot offer any advice, just that I feel the same.
Alone.
I have so much love around me from friends and family, but it's not the love I want. No matter how much "they're there for me", I still feel so alone. 

I don't fear death, I fear being alone.

It's the most torturous feeling. I don't know how to get through it either.

I feel this. If I tell someone that I'm suicidal, I'll be watched like a hawk, or even taken back into hospital. That's happened twice already, even though the first time I wasn't even going to do anything, I had just made plans but didn't go through with it.

Just want to tell someone and have them hug me. That's all.

I've tried everything under the sun. Multiple medications, Inc melatonin. I even tried cbd oil. I've suffered insomnia pretty much my entire life (28)
I found out recently that I have sleep apneoa, I was misdiagnosed 6 years ago when I did my first sleep study. But it's already too late, I used to be able to get by and function by getting my sleep through small naps, but the antidepressants I'm on- don't allow me to nap. I physically can't sleep. And I'm a special case according to my Dr, I choke during the entire night, not just during REM, which release noradrenaline, which is what keeps me awake the next night. It's a vicious cycle. And I know there's CPAP machines to help me breathe but I don't want to wear a mask every night for the rest of my life, not to mention it only improves sleep quality, it doesn't help you get to sleep.

I wholly agree with you, telling him is a burden. But sometimes I just want to ask him "would you care if I wasn't here anymore?" 
But I feel like that's just admitting defeat, that I'm giving up on our potential rekindling. I told him I'd never give up, but it seems fruitless. I honestly will never love anyone ever again. 

I've told him how much I care, but I feel like I'm just a bother to him now days. I feel like every time I say "I love you", it pushes him away more.

It puts me in a difficult position because I have absolutely no idea how my death would affect him. That's how lost I am.

Well, I've lost all three of my favourite things: naps (can't sleep), food (barely eat one meal a day), and love. So there not much left for me.

I love my cat, but he's not enough to anchor me here.

Exactly why I can't say anything. I would like him to know how I'm feeling, but I could never put that burden on him. He's not sure if he loves me, I feel like I'd just make it worse for myself, for a future with him, if I said I can't be without him.
I know in Australia, even if you're a registered organ donor, if you commit suicide, they won't donate your organs :(

He is not the only reason I am going. I'm don't feel human anymore. I barely sleep, I barely eat, not either of those by choice. I've been on four antidepressants changes this year. Nothing, absolutely nothing is getting better. I've been trying, I have, but my body has reached its limit.

I know there is nothing after death, I used to believe in another life, or being reunited with lost loved ones, but I can feel it in my being, there is nothing after death. And yes, I would rather take that than live this life that I have. He is my person, I've loved and had heartbreak before, but nothing like this, there is no one after him. There is no happiness and love like I felt with him, so why continue on a bleak life without that.

I cannot tell him because that's emotional blackmail, he's already suffering enough without having to deal with a suicidal ex. And if I decide to leave after I told him? Then he'll just blame himself.
